tool.name: ampvis2 venn diagram

configfiles.configfile: #load ampvis2 library(ampvis2) #load input load('$input') #create output amp_venn( '$input', group='$group', min_abundance='$min_abundance', min_samples='$min_samples', min_groups='$min_groups', output='$output', format='$format', width=$width, height=$height )

param.name: input
param.label: Ampvis2 dataset
param.help: An ampvis2 RDS dataset obtained by the ``ampvis2: load`` tool (or ``ampvis2: mergereplicates`` or one of the ``ampvis2: subset ...`` tools).

param.name: group
param.label: Grouping variable
param.help: The grouping variable to use for the analysis.

param.name: min_abundance
param.label: Minimum abundance
param.help: Minimum abundance of the OTU in a sample to be considered present in that sample.

param.name: min_samples
param.label: Minimum number of samples
param.help: Minimum number of samples in a group where the OTU is present to be considered present in that group.

param.name: min_groups
param.label: Minimum number of groups
param.help: Minimum number of groups where the OTU is present to be considered present in the venn diagram.

param.name: format
param.label: Output format
param.help: The output format of the plot.

param.name: width
param.label: Plot width
param.help: The width of the plot in cm.

param.name: height
param.label: Plot height
param.help: The height of the plot in cm.

tool.help:
What it does ============
Calculates the number of "core" OTUs shared by groups given thresholds for how frequent the OTUs should be above a certain abundance. Also returns the average abundance of the OTUs in a particular group.
The Galaxy tool calls the `amp_venn <https://kasperskytte.github.io/ampvis2/reference/amp_venn.html>`_ function of the ampvis2 package.
Preserving relative abundances in a subset of larger data =========================================================
By default the raw read counts in the abundance matrix are normalised example ``ampvis2: heatmap``, ``ampvis2: timeseries``, and more). (transformed to percentages) by some ampvis2 plotting tools (for If this is applied to data generated by one of the ``ampvis2: subset ...`` tools this means that the relative abundances shown will be calculated based on the remaining taxa after the subset, not including the removed taxa, if any. To circumvent this, enable ``normalise`` when subsetting with the ``ampvis2: subset ...``` tools, and then disable ``normalise`` in the plotting tool. This will transform the OTU counts to relative abundances BEFORE the subset. Input ===== An ampvis2 RDS dataset obtained by the ``ampvis2: load`` tool (or ``ampvis2: mergereplicates`` or one of the ``ampvis2: subset ...`` tools).
